headline: Weathered Expanse Rages as Mooring County Battle Quickens
war_summary: Since the last edition the Weathered Expanse has boiled anew with eleven changes in two hours and sixty-one on the day about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch, holdings now three Warden, four Colonial and two unheld with day losses 8,337 Colonial and 11,317 Warden; Mooring County stands nine Warden to three Colonial with four changes in two hours and twenty-eight on the day centred on Gravekeeper's Holdfast and Wiccwalk, day losses 6,549 Colonial and 5,741 Warden. Callahan's Passage, now ten Warden, has stirred again with three changes in two hours and sixteen on the day about Crumbling Post. The Nevish Line at five Warden to three Colonial remains quiet in the last six hours after twenty-one changes on the day about Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way, day losses 4,531 Colonial and 5,285 Warden. Palantine Berm, seven Warden, is quiet in two hours after five in six and fifteen on the day about The Pippeli Stones and The Droll, while Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row record no changes in six hours.
